title: Alert Payload v1
description: payload for an envelope with eventType='alert', schemaVersion=1. A condition the device has detected, raised or cleared. The device owns the alert: the platform never derives clearance, so a raised alert stays active until the device sends 'cleared' for the same code and component.

code.description: Stable machine-readable condition, e.g. LOW_FUEL, TYRE_PRESSURE_LOW.

component.description: Which part the condition concerns when a code can apply to several (a tyre position). Together with 'code' it identifies the alert.
